entities.summary: Zabihollah Pourshab more commonly known as Zabihollah Poursheib is a retired Iranian karateka. Pourshab competed at the 2010 Asian Games at the 84 kg division and won the gold medal. He also won the bronze medal in 2016 World Karate Championships.
